title: 3767. Maximize Points After Choosing K Tasks

examples.explanation: We must complete at least k = 2 tasks using technique1. Choosing technique1[1] and technique1[2] (completed using technique 1), and technique2[0] (completed using technique 2), yields the maximum points: 2 + 10 + 10 = 22.
We must complete at least k = 2 tasks using technique1. Choosing all tasks using technique 1 yields the maximum points: 10 + 20 + 30 = 60.
Since k = 0, we are not required to choose any task using technique1. Choosing all tasks using technique 2 yields the maximum points: 4 + 5 + 6 = 15.

hints: Initially complete all tasks using way 1; let the initial total be sum(reward1).
The delta when switching task i from way 1 to way 2 is reward2[i] - reward1[i].
Sort deltas descending and apply the largest n - k; after each switch update the maximum.
